name: Prism ML Server
author: jaimegh-es
description: Local Prism ML model server (mirrors PrismML-Eng/Bonsai-demo). Auto-detects your GPU (CUDA / ROCm / Vulkan / CPU), downloads the llama.cpp binaries and the Bonsai / Ternary-Bonsai GGUF models (1.7B / 4B / 8B / 27B), and runs llama-server on localhost with a /health endpoint. Includes a welcome-style wizard in the terminal (sayri-prismml wizard) and a browser panel (sayri-prismml serve).

ui.sync_instructions:
Open a terminal and run:

  sayri-prismml wizard      # interactive wizard (install and start)
  sayri-prismml status      # server status
